evals.prompt: Create a sales dashboard as a single HTML page for our Q3 numbers. Revenue was $4.2M (up 18% QoQ), 312 new customers, churn 2.1%, pipeline $9.8M. Break revenue down by region (NA 52%, EMEA 31%, APAC 17%) and show the monthly trend Jul/Aug/Sep: 1.2M, 1.4M, 1.6M. Top 5 reps table too, make up plausible names.
evals.expected_output: A single HTML file with clear hierarchy (headline metrics lead), a deliberate type and color system with one accent, directly labeled charts, and no generic tells. Response is brief with no narration of the design process.
assertions: A single HTML file is saved in outputs
The reply to the user is brief and does not narrate design passes or techniques
No placeholder text or obviously fake names (lorem ipsum, John Doe)
Chart or section titles state a finding rather than only a topic

evals.prompt: Make a presentation deck (6-8 slides) pitching our leadership team on moving the support team to a 4-day week pilot. Key points: burnout scores up 30% this year, two competitors already do it, proposed 3-month pilot with 12 people, success measured by CSAT and ticket resolution time, cost is basically zero.
evals.expected_output: A deck with varied slide rhythm (not all title plus bullets), takeaway-sentence titles, large readable type, consistent margins, and one emphasized statistic. Response is brief.
assertions: A single self-contained HTML deck with 6-8 slides is saved in outputs
All five key points from the request are covered
The reply to the user is brief and does not narrate design passes or techniques
Not every slide is a title plus bullet list (at least two distinct slide layouts)
Slide titles are takeaway sentences rather than topic labels

evals.prompt: I need a one-page PDF report summarizing our customer survey: 1,240 responses, NPS 47 (was 39), top complaint is onboarding complexity (38% mention), top praise is support responsiveness (61%). Three recommendations: simplify setup wizard, add in-app guides, keep support staffing. It's going to the exec team.
evals.expected_output: A one-page PDF with editorial hierarchy, a finding-led headline, the NPS change as the focal point, real margins, and survives grayscale. Response is brief.
assertions: A PDF is saved in outputs and is exactly one page
All given figures appear correctly (1,240, NPS 47 from 39, 38%, 61%) and all three recommendations
The reply to the user is brief and does not narrate design passes or techniques
The headline states a finding rather than only a topic
